about: What a live review-deep run against the goeval fixture should find. live_eval_go.py scores a run's STATE_DIR against this. Each defect's anchor is a unique substring on its line; live_eval_go.py resolves the line number itself instead of storing one, since a real run never rewrites the fixture's files. defects marked cross_component span both components and carry two locations; only a sweep arm sees the whole ledger and can connect them.

defects.why: Authenticate grants access to any request carrying X-Debug-Bypass: true, a hardcoded auth bypass with no key check.
LabelHandler reaches across the component boundary into warehouse's exported database handle instead of calling a warehouse function, coupling shipping to warehouse's internal schema.
RateCalculator depends on the concrete FedExClient instead of a Carrier interface, so adding a second carrier means editing RateCalculator itself (DIP/OCP violation).
NewStock never sets PriceInfo, so Price() nil-dereferences on any SKU that has not been priced yet.

locations.anchor: func ApplyDiscount(price float64, pct float64) float64 {

defects.why: No test in the repository covers ApplyDiscount, including zero quantity, a negative pct, or pct >= 1.
Serve installs no signal handler, so a deploy's SIGTERM kills in-flight requests instead of draining them.

locations.anchor: RawDB.QueryRow("SELECT sku, quantity, warehouse_id FROM stock WHERE sku = ?", sku)

defects.why: LoadMany issues one query per SKU inside a loop instead of a single batched statement (N+1).
UnusedHelper has no caller anywhere in the repository; it is dead code.
createStockTable declares sku with no PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraint, so duplicate SKU rows can be inserted.

warehouse publishes StockUpdate.WeightKG in kilograms under the JSON key "weight"; shipping decodes the same key into stockEvent.Weight and prices it as grams, a 1000x error. A component-only reviewer sees only one file and has no reason to doubt its own comment; only a sweep arm holding the whole ledger can read both files and catch the disagreement.
